PwC JD Full-Stack / AI Platform Engineer (Senior Associate)

Job Requisition ID: 736705WD Location: Bangalore Bagmane Tech Park Experience: 4+ years Job Type: Full-time, Regular Domain: Data, Analytics & AI




1. Mandatory Skills

Skill Category




Required Skills

Full-Stack Development




Strong TypeScript, React.js, Node.js

Frontend Framework




Strong Next.js, especially App Router

Backend Development




Python (FastAPI/Flask) and/or Node.js (Express)

Programming




Strong Python skills

Database




Working knowledge of SQL

AI/ML




Hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions

Agentic AI




Experience with agentic AI and orchestration frameworks

LLM Integration




Experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs into production applications

Deployment




Docker and containerized deployment workflows

Experience




Minimum 4 years of professional experience

Education




Bachelor's degree or higher

Communication




Good English communication skills, written and verbal




2. Required AI Frameworks and Technologies

Candidates should have hands-on experience with at least one or more of the following agentic AI frameworks:

LangChain
LangGraph
Claude Agent SDK
Job queues and event-driven systems
LLM APIs and production AI integrations



3. Preferred / Additional Skills

These are additional skills mentioned in the JD and should strengthen a candidate's profile:

Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP
Predictive modeling and machine learning using Python or SAS
Statistical modeling and data analysis
Data manipulation and visualization
Algorithm development and optimization
Application security
Scalable AI solution deployment
Client-facing experience and mentoring junior team members
